tagline: A working link in 10 days. A fixed price. A date in writing.
brief: A one-person build practice selling a productised offer to non-technical founders. The site is set as a well-built instrument: concrete and graphite, one safety-orange signal that marks action. The mark replaces the plain-text name in the header.
criteria: Success: comes out of the site's own system, reads at 16 px, works in one colour, avoids the developer clichés (</>, >_, rockets).

concepts.name: Key
concepts.idea: The site's booking key: an A on the signal face, with the graphite edge and hard offset every key on the site has.
rationale: The mark and the one call to action are the same object
Orange keeps its single job on the site: it marks action
A heavier small-size drawing keeps the A legible at 16 px

recommendation: Key: built from the site's own component, legible at favicon size, and it works in one colour.
next_steps: Swap the header wordmark for the mark
Regenerate the OG image with the lockup
